reasoning: The question asks about the probability that the 25-year 11-month Euro-area government bond par yield on 2026-10-18 will exceed its value on 2026-10-11. The evidence shows significant bond market volatility in the Eurozone as of October 9, 2026, with German 10-year yields at 3.49% (peaked at 3.65% on Sept 28), rising inflation (3.8%), and ECB maintaining restrictive policy at 2.50% deposit rate. Markets expect further rate hikes. The environment shows upward pressure on yields from inflation concerns, fiscal tensions (especially France), and energy prices. However, week-to-week movements are essentially random walks with slight drift. Given the current upward trend in yields but inherent daily volatility, I estimate roughly 50-55% probability of an increase over this one-week period.
